ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Allcargo Global Limited reported a significant financial turnaround in Q2 FY27, achieving net profitability (PAT of INR 32 crores) and substantial EBITDA growth (INR 122 crores), primarily driven by a 27% YoY revenue increase from elevated freight rates. This robust performance, achieved despite volume declines, was underpinned by strong cost control and strategic technology investments, though net debt saw a modest rise due to increased working capital. While current freight rate tailwinds are expected to soften, management is confident in sustained growth through ongoing business initiatives, with a historical bad debt provision anticipated to normalize.
